page.overview:
Who is Brother Gunther?

Brother Gunther was a stalwart Warrior Priest of Sigmar and follower of Stefan von Kessel.

A Warrior Priest of Sigmar and staunch defender of the Empire, Gunther follows the warrior's ideals of his god. Armed with his blessed warhammer, Gunther fights at the forefront of the battle against Chaos. However, it is his knowledge of the Enemy within that poses the greatest threat to the followers of Chaos and there are those who would prefer to see him dead. Assured, well studied and deeply faithful, Gunther is as comfortable leading men in quiet, contemplative prayer as he is with stentorian bellows over the clash of arms.
